title: Receivers expose different operations
purpose: Explain heterogeneous vendor receiver interfaces that Command hides from the invoker.
alt: 서로 다른 메서드를 제공하는 14개 가전 수신자 클래스와 공통 명령 인터페이스가 필요한 이유
requiredChecks: All fourteen original receiver classes are present, including SecurityControl.arm() and disarm().
All methods remain under the correct receiver; FaucetControl uses openValve() and closeValve().
Independent class cards show varied APIs and the Command-wrapping caption; no invented superclass.
prompt: Edit vendor chart: preserve existing thirteen receivers and methods; add SecurityControl with arm() and disarm(). Put Light and SecurityControl in the last row; correct FaucetControl openValve()/closeValve(); retain differing APIs caption.
